settings.title: Hue Bridge connection
settings.subtitle: Enter your Bridge details to use the Tap Dial.
settings.press_link_button: Press the round link button on the Hue Bridge now. Then click ‘I pressed it’.
settings.enter_ip: Enter the Hue Bridge IP address first.
settings.connected: Connected. The application key has been saved.
settings.invalid_ip: Enter a private network IP address for your Hue Bridge.
settings.link_not_pressed: The Bridge did not detect the link button. Press it and try again.
settings.bridge_timeout: The Hue Bridge did not respond in time. Check the IP address and try again.
settings.bridge_unreachable: Could not reach the Hue Bridge. Check that Homey and the Bridge are on the same network.
settings.bridge_rejected: The Hue Bridge could not create an application key. Try again.
